purpose: The runtime stop chain: one row per stop, each bound to the archived runs that establish it. Validated by scripts/check-stop-chain.py, which refuses a row that claims more than its cited archives show. This is a record-consistency gate, NOT a fidelity claim and NOT proof that a run reached the title screen.

stops.note: A complete 4482-byte C++ virtual method with no analysis-database entry, reached only as slot 2 of the .rdata vtable at 0x001CD290. Zero rel32 callers. Both cited runs log an ABI-verified return.
g03 found it as an unresolved call and did NOT execute it; g05 executed it. stack_args 8 is INFERRED, not derived: seven indirect calls on the walk leave the depth unresolved.
g04 found it; g05 confirmed it. Zero rel32 callers, one .data reference at 0x001FA1C0.

A this-adjusting thunk ending in `jmp [ecx+0x6c]`, so its cleanup is the tail target's `ret 0xc`. g05 FOUND it and does not descend from its own repair commit, which is why it is cited as `discovered` there and not as a confirmation. g06 ran 905 s and never reached it -- recorded as not_exercised, which is not a pass. g07 and g08 both confirmed it.

An under-wide span that cut its own jump table at 0x000B5F0F, so the lifter emitted RECOMP_ITAIL and the guest trapped on the 0xB5F82 arm. Repaired from the bytes by 64945a3, then NOT exercised by two consecutive runs (g07 found it, g08 aborted at 0x48DB0 first). CONFIRMED at last by f9, which descends from the repair and logs its ABI-verified return. Note g07 does NOT descend from 64945a3 either, which is why it is cited as `discovered` and never as a confirmation.

g08 measured `ABI FAILURE 0x00048DB0 esp 00F7FE50->00F7FDA8 expected +4`, an observed delta of -0xA8 that is exactly its prologue (`sub esp,0x98` plus four pushes). Repaired by 892dd1e to end 0x000496B7 with stack_args 8. g08 does NOT descend from the repair, so it is cited only as `discovered`; f9 confirms the ABI-verified return.

A PROVED static production defect (TR section 17): its declared end 0xB0811 is a tail_jump_alias start inside its own body, so its epilogue at 0xB09DC lay outside the span and the emitted body called the fatal trap stub sub_000B09DC TWICE and sub_000B09D9 FOUR times. (An earlier revision of this row, of TR section 17 and of the plan had those two counts reversed; the erratum is TR section 18. The counts here are re-measured from the archived pre-repair body in the g08 source.zip.) Repaired as end 0xB09E0. NO archived run has been observed to reach it, so it has no evidence rows and cannot claim any runtime state. The evidence list is empty on purpose: an empty list is checked, and it is not a pass.

An uncovered pointer in the same .data table 0x1F97B4 that owns 0x00048DB0. Added as [0x00048690, 0x000488AA) with stack_args 8, derived from the bytes. Never dispatched in any archived run, so it has no runtime evidence and claims none.

The row is keyed on the repaired ENTRY 0x000AE560, not on 0x000AE655: the latter is this function's shared epilogue (`pop esi` at 0xAE5ED, `ret 4` at 0xAE5EE), reached by seven conditional branches from inside the body, and it is never entered as a function, so it can never have an ABI-verified return line of its own. The declared end 0x000AE5F1 cut that epilogue off, so the lifter emitted a trap for 0x000AE655 and f9 logged `[ICALL] Failed to resolve VA 0x000AE655` with 0x000AE560 as ICALL-history frame 15. The end is now 0x000AE659 and stack_args 4 was already correct (both exits are `ret 4` at depth 0). f10, which descends from the repair 0445a80, logs 0x000AE560's ABI-verified return and confirms it. This is the first stop the structural census predicted before any run reached it.

An unowned gap: no manifest span, no owner and no dispatch tuple, so an indirect call to it trapped. f10 logged `[ICALL] Failed to resolve VA 0x00096560` (with 0x00096560 as ICALL-history frame 15), which is the DISCOVERY. Recovered as [0x00096560, 0x000967AA) with stack_args 4 from a fully enumerated walk (two exits, both `ret 4` at 0x967A7, at least one at depth 0); its only image reference is the aligned .rdata dword at 0x001CD32C. The recovery landed in fc6f2d4. CONFIRMED by f12, which descends from that commit and logs `[RECOVERED] 0x00096560 returned; ABI verified`. Discovery and confirmation are two different runs and are cited as such.

The sibling of 0x00096560: no manifest span, no owner and no dispatch tuple, with a byte-identical prologue. Recovered as [0x00096B60, 0x00096DBA) with stack_args 4 from a fully enumerated 180-instruction walk (two exits, both `ret 4` at 0x96DB7, one at depth 0); its only image reference is the aligned .rdata dword at 0x001CD3AC. The recovery landed in 46f5c48. CONFIRMED by f13, which descends from that commit and logs the ABI-verified return.

The 927-instruction gap immediately after 0x00080BD0's corrected end 0x00081853, separated from it by thirteen NOP bytes and tail-jumped to by two manifest entries (0x00082770, 0x00082790). f13 logged `[ICALL] Failed to resolve VA 0x00081860` after confirming stop 27. Recovered as [0x00081860, 0x0008274B) with stack_args 4: five exits, all `ret 4`, at least one at depth 0. The repair is in the working tree; no run has executed it, so the state stays REPAIRED, the evidence stays `discovered`, and the row carries no repair_commit until one exists.

The fatal `[ICALL] Failed to resolve VA 0x00159330` that ends the title run (0xE0424943) after the method-admission class clears. Unlike every earlier stop this one is NOT a mis-sized or swallowed span: the function has no analysis-database entry at all, because it is reached ONLY by an indirect call, so no direct call site ever recorded it and no decode pass saw it. The address is a complete function: 0x00159321-0x0015932F is NOP padding, 0x00159330 begins a clean prologue (push ecx; push esi; mov esi,[esp+0xC]), the body runs to 0x00159416 `ret 0xc`, and 0x00159419-0x0015941F is further NOP padding before the next function at 0x00159420. Recovered as [0x00159330, 0x00159419) with stack_args 12 -- the epilogue returns 12 bytes of arguments, and check-stack-depth.py reported DEFECT/STACK_ARGS when that was first omitted, so the gate is what caught it. First reproduced in 20261007-122836-322-title008-witness-1A30-long (unhandled_exception at 624 s, the same failure at the end of the 900 s budget). The repair is committed. A 900 s run on the repaired build completes without the ICALL failure (zero [ICALL] Failed, [EXCEPTION] and [PFIFO] reject lines), but check-run-exercised.py reports no clean ABI-verified return for this address, and that checker measures clean returns rather than entry coverage -- so runtime confirmation is ABSENT and entry coverage is UNQUALIFIED. The state stays REPAIRED and no repair_commit is recorded until a run confirms it.

The fatal `[ICALL] Failed to resolve VA 0x000C2730` (0xE0424943) that ended the 900 s frame-dump run at presents 2442 / 588 s. This is the abutting-alias class recover-functions.py exists for: the analysis database carries FIVE overlapping tail_jump_alias entries (sub_000C2480, sub_000C2500, sub_000C2560, sub_000C25D0, sub_000C2700) all claiming to end at 0x000C276F, and the manifest entry 0x000C2700 declared that same end, so 0x000C2730 had no entry and the span that should have stopped short ran over it. The original XBE shows a complete function: `ret` at 0x000C2724, a two-instruction tail ending in `ret` at 0x000C272C, NOP padding at 0x000C272D-0x000C272F, then a clean prologue at 0x000C2730 (sub esp,0x18; push esi; mov esi,ecx) running to `ret` at 0x000C276E. Fixed two ways, both required: 0x000C2730 recovered as [0x000C2730, 0x000C276F) with stack_args 0, and the 0x000C2700 entry end narrowed to 0x000C272D -- check-hidden-entries.py reported OVERLAP and named that boundary, which is the gate doing its job. Four sibling entries still carry the original over-run in the analysis database but are already narrowed in the manifest, so they are residue rather than open defects. The repair is committed; no run has yet confirmed execution, so the state stays REPAIRED and no repair_commit is recorded.

The fatal `[ICALL] Failed to resolve VA 0x000C3410` (0xE0424943) at presents 2443, in the same abutting-alias class as stop 30 and the same region. Seven overlapping tail_jump_alias entries (sub_000C2FE0, sub_000C30C0, sub_000C3100, sub_000C3140, sub_000C31B0, sub_000C3350, sub_000C33C0) all declare an end of 0x000C3670, and the manifest entry 0x000C33C0 declared 0x000C3500, so the address had no entry of its own. The XBE shows `ret` at 0x000C3407, NOP padding at 0x000C3408-0x000C340F, then a clean prologue at 0x000C3410 (sub esp,0x2c; push esi; mov esi,ecx). Fixed both ways: 0x000C3410 recovered as [0x000C3410, 0x000C3670) with stack_args 0, and 0x000C33C0 ended at 0x000C3408 -- check-hidden-entries.py --show-all named that boundary. IMPORTANT PROVENANCE: this run proves stop 30 was EXERCISED. 0x000C2730 returned with a clean ABI check once before the failure moved on, so the previous repair works and the stop chain advanced by exactly one address. The state here stays REPAIRED because no run has yet confirmed THIS address executing.

The fatal `[ICALL] Failed to resolve VA 0x0009188C` (0xE0424943) that ended R3 at 236.5 s / presents 2885; the ICALL history names 0x00091830 as frame 15. 0x0009188C is not a function: it is the target of the je at 0x00091878 inside 0x00091830, whose recovered entry had been ended at 0x00091882 -- the analysis database's tail_jump_alias entry sub_00091882, a push ecx mid-function with no caller and no pointer to it (its one raw dword match is inside DSOUND data). The XBE shows one function: sub esp,0xc and three pushes at 0x00091830, pop edi/esi/ebx, add esp,0xc, ret at 0x000918A0, NOP padding to 0x000918AF, next function 0x000918B0. Fixed by widening the entry to [0x00091830, 0x000918A1); the je became an internal goto and 0x0009188C left recovery-unresolved.json. NOT YET EXERCISED: the first run on the repaired tree (20261009-160259-224-title011-9188C-fixed, uncommitted tree) stalled at presents 2429 in the game's own fatal-error path (JSRF_FATAL.ERR) before reaching this address. CONFIRMED by 20261009-225354-960-title012-m15-long (game 82f80f1, toolkit 60bf20a): 0x00091830 returned with a clean ABI check, and the run went on past R3's crash point (2885 presents at 1157 s) to the title screen.

The fatal `[ICALL] Failed to resolve VA 0x000BE190` (0xE0424943) that ended the M15 run at 1598 s / presents 3135 (and its reproduction at 1696 s), after the title screen. 0x000BE190 is a scalar deleting destructor reached only through slot 0 of the vtable at 0x001CDAE0 (its one raw dword in the XBE), so it has no analysis-database entry; the recovered entry 0x000BDFD0 declared end 0x000BE1B0 and swallowed it, lifting its switch and index tables (0x000BE17C, 0x000BE188) as junk. Fixed: 0x000BDFD0 ended at 0x000BE17B (its last ret 4 is at 0x000BE178), 0x000BE190 recovered as [0x000BE190, 0x000BE1AE) with stack_args 4, and its callee 0x000BDAE0 (the destructor, no entry anywhere) as [0x000BDAE0, 0x000BDB92). check-hidden-entries.py reported the OVER_RUN but found no evidenced entry, because a .rdata vtable slot behind a jump table is not evidence it recognises. NOT YET EXERCISED.

Fatal `[ICALL] Failed to resolve VA 0x001BE689` (0xE0424943) at ms=479789734 in the first run where the emulated Xbox pad enumerated (K16, ledger L57). It is reached immediately after SET_CONFIGURATION(1) completes, so it is inside the driver's post-configuration path (its object-building code at 0x001BE689 reads `word [0x2647B2]` and `dword [0x2647B4]`). 0x001BE689 has NO function record in tools/disasm/output/functions.json, and the bytes at that address are a bare `mov ax, word ptr [0x2647b2]` with no prologue, so it is an indirect-call target rather than a function entry -- the same class as stops 29-32 (0x00159330, 0x000C2730, 0x000C3410, 0x000BE190): a function nothing calls directly, so no decode pass lifted it. Closing it needs the real entry extent recovered from the XBE and the ICALL-history frames preserved. NOT yet repaired: no recovery entry exists. REPAIRED: recovery entry [0x001BE689, 0x001BE7DE), stack_args 4, added to config/recovered-functions.json; run 20261010-025008-492 shows `[RECOVERED] 0x001BE689 returned; ABI verified (ESP/EBX/ESI/EDI)` and the stop chain advanced exactly one address, to 0x001BDE21.

Fatal `[ICALL] Failed to resolve VA 0x001BDE21` (0xE0424943) immediately after stop 34 was repaired and returned, i.e. the chain advanced exactly one address. Reached only by an indirect call, so no decode pass lifted it; the analysis database has no entry and the region below is uncovered (nearest span below is sub_001BD621 [0x001BD621, 0x001BD63B), next is 0x001BE7DE). Bytes are a complete function: follows a clean `pop edi; pop esi; pop ebx; ret 8` at 0x001BDE1B-0x001BDE1E, takes `this` in ECX, copies 8-byte records from [eax+0x34] to [eax+0x14] for the count at [eax+0x66], bare `ret` at 0x001BDE5C. REPAIRED: recovery entry [0x001BDE21, 0x001BDE5D), stack_args 0. The end had to be one byte PAST the `ret` (0x001BDE5D, not 0x001BDE5C), or the body has no epilogue and returns with ESP unmoved -- measured as `ABI FAILURE 0x001BDE21 esp ... expected +4` in run 20261010-025515-426. After the correction, run 20261010-030025-850 shows `[RECOVERED] 0x001BDE21 returned; ABI verified (ESP/EBX/ESI/EDI)`. THIRD correction: the extent also had to include the `jmp 0x14b41e` at 0x001BDE5D (a target of the `jne 0x1bde5d` at 0x001BDE4B), so end is 0x001BDE62 -- the 5-byte jmp's end. With end 0x001BDE5D the lifter emitted a call to sub_001BDE5D, which is not a function, and the run died on `[ICALL] Failed to resolve VA 0x001BDE5D`. repair_commit ab4e7f1, confirmed by 20261010-082548-322 (same revision).
